headline: Growth continues, margins expand, guidance reaffirmed
summary_short: Revenue rose 5.6% y/y to $10,777M and operating income rose 7.4% to $2,079M. Net income rose 12.1% y/y to $1,479M, helped by gains on divestitures, and diluted EPS reached $2.21, up 13.9% y/y.
summary_long: Growth was broad-based: Americas Materials Solutions revenue rose 10% y/y on pricing and acquisitions; Americas Building Solutions fell 2% on divestitures and soft residential demand; International Solutions rose 5% on pricing and volume. Adjusted EBITDA margin rose 30bps to 24.4%. CRH reaffirmed FY26 guidance for net income ($3.9-4.1bn), Adjusted EBITDA ($8.1-8.5bn) and diluted EPS ($5.60-6.05), but lowered capex guidance to $2.7-2.9bn from $2.8-3.0bn. It agreed to acquire Arcosa for $8.5bn cash and paused share buybacks pending that close, after repurchasing $0.3bn in Q2. Cash was $3.0bn; net debt rose to $15.4bn (from $14.2bn at YE2025) on acquisitions and shareholder returns, partly offset by $1.7bn of divestiture proceeds.

drivers.explanation: Broad-based growth: Americas Materials +10% and International Solutions +5% on pricing and acquisitions, partly offset by Americas Building Solutions -2% from divestitures and soft residential demand.
Release attributes profit growth to disciplined commercial execution, performance-improvement initiatives and acquisition contributions, partly offset by cost inflation.
Same segment drivers as operating income — pricing, cost discipline and M&A contributions; company's own Adjusted EBITDA margin rose 30bps to 24.4%.
Driven by strong operating performance and $282M of net gains on divestitures (vs a $9M expense a year ago), partly offset by income tax expense rising to $661M from $425M.
Reaffirmed FY26 net income, Adjusted EBITDA and diluted EPS guidance; lowered FY26 capex guidance to $2.7-2.9bn (from $2.8-3.0bn) on project timing and lower maintenance spend.
